simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַמִּיץ (H533) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.

simple.summary: אַמִּיץ (ʼammîyts) means strong or (abstractly) strength First listed occurrence: 2Sam 15 12.

definitions.full: H533. ammits אַמִּיץ (אַמִּץ) adjective mighty — ׳א absolute 2Sam 15:12 2 t.; construct Job 9:4 2 t. — mighty , of Absa-lom's conspiracy 2Sam 15:12 ; elsewhere of persons; as substantive, instrum. of ׳י (i.e. Assyrians) Isa 28:2 (|| חזָק ; ׳א לִבּוֺ = valiant, conqueror Amos 2:16 ; of וְא לֵבָב ׳חֲכַם כֹּחַ ׳י, Job 9:4 ; compare א ׳כֹּחַ 9:19 (see Di & RV), ׳א כֹּחַ Isa 40:26 read probably אֹמֶץ ( ᵐ5 ) (|| אוֺנִים רֹב ).
